bestBets.overview: CONVAAYA has good foundation in this 2100 and 2200m distance range. Placed in latest run here two start back on the synthetic, her second placing on the track. SMART MOVES showed benefit of racing when improving at third third run from spell which was here at same distance. Has pace to use the draw. JUST SWIFT jumps sharply in distance, but has a big bank of runs over 1500 and 1600m so should handle the rise in distance. Races like a stayer. ONLY OPERA has always looked like a mare who would be better when stepped up to staying distances. Firmer surface might be a plus and did trial nicely here on the synthetic before current campaign.

raceTips.comment: Convaaya was costly as a short-priced favourite at Hamilton last start but prepared to forgive that effort as he seems to struggle on wet ground. His only two starts on the Ballarat synthetic have been encouraging, with a narrow second to Camelot Time and a brave third in a fast-run race behind Wolfoffitroystreet. He maps to get the run of the race from the inside draw and should be in the finish with even luck. Just Swift is the x-factor jumping sharply from 1600m to 2100m. She is forever getting back and running on at the shorter trips, so can see why Mitch Freedman is now having a throw at a staying trip. The slight concern is she did get keen in her most recent start, where the tempo was genuine, so just mindful she maps to be back from the wide draw and could over race if the speed of the race drops. Smart Moves has improved with each run since joining the Rogers stable and could be hard to run down if he gets a soft lead.

raceTips.comment: Peace Seeker can improve coming back to Ballarat and also dropping to 1200m. She seemed to struggle at 1400m last start and was much more effective at this track and trip in her start prior. The wide draw seems scary but she ran well when racing from a wide draw two starts back and appeared to appreciate the room to wind through her gears. Fire In Your Heart had trialled well on this surface prior to her debut at Geelong. Her effort last start is better than what it looks given the pattern of the day and where she settled from the wide draw. Havana Moon was okay here behind Saludar, who has since won again, and while she is clearly a winning chance, not sold that she should be as short as what she is in early betting.

bestBets.overview: Quite good depth here with several on the cusp of their maiden breakthrough. LANCETTA has placed in both starts here over the 1500m and beaten margins reducing in each run suggest she is ready to peak here and has services of leading rider. DON'T SAY NO MIKKI jumped sharply in distance to 1400m and was just cut back late. Wide margin to third a positive sign. Sure to improve with run in this distance range. CORRETTO appreciated the drop in class, drier track and rise in distance at second start when able to get forward. Winner of that race was $2.00 debutant. COLLECTIONNEUR was held up here on debut when needing to build momentum and worked home solidly up the inside when it was all over. Suited longer trip. Think the winner has plenty of upside. BRADFORD ran well here when stepped up to 1400m. Ran good last sectional in other synthetic run at Pakenham over 1200m so the 1500m should be okay. PRIDE OF MANDY was easily best on pacer from last start and stuck on well. Nice pace, can use the barrier draw. Best roughie.

raceTips.comment: Collectionneur had excuses on debut when third to impressive winner In'kantosstar. She was never going to beat the short-price favourite, but she raced in restricted room at a stage of the race where she was hoping to improve. The rise in distance seems ideal and might have more upside than her rivals. Lancetta hasn't been far from a win in both starts this preparation and should be at peak fitness now third-up. Corretto might have bumped into a smart one last start and maps to be well positioned from the inside draw.

raceTips.comment: Taking a very different view to this race than the early market and feel Angry Skies is as good a chance as any to win. It's an extremely open race and the pace could be willing early, which might help the chances of Angry Skies. He is a duffer on wet ground, so prepared to overlook the first two runs of his preparation and feel he could jump out of the ground on the synthetic track. Reset The Jazz has been building nicely this campaign and should now be fit enough to run well third-up. He deserves the big weight and is the best performed horse in the race. Kengero scored a strong win at Pakenham synthetic three starts back and has since run well at metro grade in Melbourne and Adelaide. Surreal I Am has thrived on synthetic tracks since moving to Melbourne and while a solid chance, the opposition he meets in this race is significantly stronger than those he has beaten in his two wins.

bestBets.overview: TORONADO BOOM ran the 2nd best last 400m of the meeting last start when finding the line nicely. Expected to run whell here after looking sharp in Flemington jumpout with D Lane on board(only ride), and he replaces apprentice rider. STARBURST was an easy winner here for apprentice last start and from the draw will be prominent. Has had a good profile with the only miss this preparation was when the track was reportedly too heavy form her second up. MARGIN CALL gets a soft run from the inside barrier and stuck on well here last start behind Speedtail, who was going well in Adelaide metro class. Both wins have been at the 1000m so drop back in distance is a positive. SISTINE TUNNEL was hard in market here first up but rider not happy with her action so can be forgiving. Ran well last start when covering ground. Gets a much better draw today.

raceTips.comment: Happy to cop the tip from Damian Lane that Toronado Boom is a great winning chance fresh off a short-break. The tip being that Lane rode in Japan over the weekend and is making his way to Ballarat for just the one ride. Lane and trainer Scott Cameron are obviously close mates and 'Frosty' was aboard when Toronado Boom won a recent jump-out at Flemington. Margin Call maps to get a cosy run on the fence and might be suited back to 1000m.

They further added that after initially responding well to his riding, Margin Call had every opportunity in the straight.
